# FIRST CVSS v4.0 reference scorer (vendored, unmodified)

Source: [FIRSTdotorg/cvss-v4-calculator](https://github.com/FIRSTdotorg/cvss-v4-calculator)
at commit `c5b0d409ae9f57c44264c6ce5f27d89298e1d32a` (2024-08-19).
License: BSD-2-Clause, in `LICENSE`. The files are byte-identical to upstream, so they can be
diffed against it. `../../cvss.mjs` loads them into a `node:vm` context, because they assign
sloppy-mode globals.
